why.h2: The hard part of Claude was never the model
why.sub: What really drains your energy is the uncertainty that has nothing to do with your work.

cards.p: From account sign-up to environment configuration, you figure out every step alone, with no one to fall back on.
Every local machine is different, and long Claude Code tasks get cut off halfway through.
Failed payments, plan changes and renewals eat into your time every month.
Hours spent researching tools and troubleshooting should go into your real work.

service.h2: Hand us the uncertainty. Keep the certainty.
service.sub: From set-up to day-to-day operations, fully managed and ready to use.

cards.p: Your own macOS account and workspace with isolated files and permissions, plus a dedicated whole-machine option on 20x. Your conversations and project data stay under your control.

Your own high-spec Mac Studio or high-spec Mac mini on local native broadband networks in Australia, the US, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Cambodia, New Zealand or Canada (never cheap shared cloud data centers). Account-level isolation (dedicated machine on 20x), stable for the long run.
Subscriptions, renewals and plan changes are all handled by us. Nothing for you to chase.
Direct 1-on-1 engineering support scaled to your plan: 7×8h (1x), 7×16h (5x), up to 7×24h round-the-clock private concierge (20x).

value.h2_html: What you get is more than compute
value.sub: The account and the machine are just the start. The real edge is having experts help you use AI the right way, more deeply and earlier than others.

cards.p: A dedicated AI engineering workspace configured and managed for you, running on a physical high-spec Mac Studio or Mac mini so long Claude Code tasks keep going.

Dedicated AI engineering guidance built for creators, developers, founders and teams alike. From Claude Code workflows, MCP and Skills set-up to shipping real projects, get 7×8h / 7×16h / 7×24h direct 1-on-1 support.
Regular updates on new features, best practices and industry news for Claude and other leading AI tools, so you adopt new capabilities first.

security.h2: Two-tier isolation: separate accounts and dedicated machines
security.sub: Your terminal carries private source code, API keys in environment variables, database settings and business logic. Zaokit ClaudeOps uses two tiers of isolation: on 1x / 5x every user gets a separate macOS account accessed only via Apple Screen Sharing; on 20x you can enable a whole dedicated machine, isolated right down to the hardware.

cards.p: With dedicated mode enabled, the entire high-spec Mac Studio or Mac mini serves only you. Install any software, change system-level settings, and use any remote desktop tool, including RustDesk and third-party VNC.

Every user has a separate macOS account with its own files and permissions, so history and project files stay private. Access is via Apple Screen Sharing only, which gives each account its own isolated desktop session that no one else can see.

Set your own access passwords and encryption policies. Our team handles connectivity and billing and does not actively access data in your account, except for maintenance, security incidents or troubleshooting you authorise.

items.a_html: Zaokit ClaudeOps is operated by an Australian registered company. Payments are processed securely by Stripe, and every payment comes with an official receipt and invoice.

items.q: How do 1x, 5x, 20x, Team and Business compare? Is there an annual discount?
items.a_html:
All five tiers scale seats, hardware isolation, concierge hours and included perks — and annual billing charges only 10 months per year (2 months free) across every tier:
• 1x Standard: Solo base allowance + Mac mini environment (separate macOS account) + 7×8h 1-on-1 support;
• 5x Pro: Solo 5× allowance + high-spec Mac mini (separate macOS account) + 7×16h priority 1-on-1 support;
• 20x Ultimate: Solo 20× allowance + high-spec Mac Studio / Mac mini (dedicated machine option) + 7×24h private concierge + private RustDesk channel + 6 TB cloud storage;
• Team (5 Seats · Dedicated Host): Available in All-Pro (1x), All-Max (5x) or All-Ultra (20x) tiers — dedicated physical Mac host for your team, seat reassignment, consolidated billing, private RustDesk channel, 6–12 TB cloud storage & 7×24h team concierge;
• Business (10 Seats · Multi-Mac Cluster): Available in All-Pro (1x), All-Max (5x) or All-Ultra (20x) tiers — dedicated multi-Mac cluster (9-country dual-region deployment & rapid migration), commercial invoicing, enterprise RustDesk relay, 12–30 TB cloud storage & 7×24h VIP SLA;
• Per-Seat Upgrade Add-ons: Start on an All-Pro or All-Max base plan and upgrade specific seats to Max (5x) or Ultra (20x) at any time via self-serve checkout (adjustable quantity 1–50 seats);
• ClaudeOps Enterprise Dedicated Line Add-on: Optional enterprise BGP cross-border acceleration for 1x (+$5/mo) and 5x (+$20/mo) subscribers (already complimentary on 20x, Team & Business).

items.q: What is the ClaudeOps Enterprise Dedicated Line add-on? Who needs it?
items.a_html:
The ClaudeOps Enterprise Dedicated Line routes your remote desktop and terminal traffic over our premium enterprise BGP cross-border backbone with self-hosted relays and dual-leg BBR congestion control, eliminating peak-hour public internet jitter and packet loss:
• 1x Dedicated Line ($5/mo · $50/yr): Designed for 1x Standard solo subscribers running daily Apple Screen Sharing, SSH and light coding;
• 5x Dedicated Line ($20/mo · $200/yr): Designed for 5x Pro engineering workloads with 5× priority bandwidth quota and high-priority BGP QoS (20% lower unit cost vs 1x);
• Included Free on Flagship & Team Tiers: 20x Ultimate, Team and Business plans already include dedicated enterprise acceleration at no extra charge.

items.q: Why is Zaokit ClaudeOps priced higher than standard cloud desktops or shared accounts?
items.a_html:
Because you are paying for deterministic physical infrastructure and white-glove engineering operations—not low-cost shared VPS instances or pooled logins. Every subscription covers four real infrastructure costs:
• High-Spec Physical Mac Hardware: Real Mac Studio and Mac mini machines (never virtualized cloud VMs), delivering sustained local compute and 24/7 reliability—with full dedicated machine isolation on 20x+;
• 200Mbps–500Mbps+ Symmetrical Native Bandwidth: Local native ISP broadband across 9 countries with generous symmetrical upload/download speeds, keeping Screen Sharing crisp and responsive instead of lagging on 10–30Mbps shared pipes;
• Enterprise BGP Backbone: Self-hosted high-speed relays over a premium HK/APAC enterprise BGP backbone with dual-leg BBR optimization, driving cross-border packet loss to zero;
• Full Official Allowance + 7×16 / 7×24 Concierge Ops: Full official subscription allowances, managed billing, iCloud/Google Drive sync, and 1-on-1 engineering support.

items.q: Separate account vs dedicated machine: why is 1x / 5x limited to Apple Screen Sharing?
items.a_html:
• Separate account isolation (1x / 5x): several users share one high-spec Mac, but each has their own macOS account, files and permissions, and no one can see anyone else's data. To protect every user's privacy, access is limited to Apple Screen Sharing, which creates an isolated desktop session for each account so your screen and activity stay private.
• Dedicated machine (available on 20x): the entire physical Mac serves only you. Hardware, system and network are fully yours. Install any software, change system-level settings and use any remote desktop tool: Apple Screen Sharing, third-party VNC such as RealVNC / TigerVNC, or our self-hosted high-speed RustDesk channel (complimentary on 20x).
Why no third-party remote tools on shared machines? RustDesk and most third-party VNC tools capture the Mac's main screen session, which on a multi-user machine could let others see or even control your desktop. We only enable them in dedicated mode. It is a deliberate privacy safeguard.

Choose 1x for everyday chat and writing, 5x if you code with Claude Code every day, and 20x for multiple agents, heavy round-the-clock use, or a dedicated machine with RustDesk and any remote desktop tool. Not sure? Start lower and upgrade any time.

items.q: What does a "deterministic, stable environment" mean in practice?
items.a_html: It means your own isolated workspace + a fixed physical high-spec Mac workstation + dedicated billing, renewal and day-to-day engineering ops. Standardized engineering operations eliminate unexpected drops, configuration conflicts and failed renewals so your workflow stays predictable.

items.q: How do I actually use it? Remote Mac or local?
items.a_html:
Both work. Use whichever suits you:
1. Remote desktop: on 1x / 5x, sign in to your separate account with macOS Screen Sharing, which is isolated, secure and ready to go. On 20x with dedicated mode enabled, you can also use third-party VNC such as RealVNC / TigerVNC, or our self-hosted high-speed RustDesk channel (complimentary on 20x) for smoother, lower-latency sessions. Either way you get the full macOS desktop and terminal, and long tasks keep running.
2. Seamless local workflow integration: collaborate with the remote development environment directly from your local workflow and dev tools, with no local environment set-up or maintenance overhead. The remote Mac becomes your dedicated compute back end.

items.q: How are my code and data kept secure and private?
items.a_html: On 1x / 5x, every user gets a separate macOS account with isolated files, permissions and desktop sessions, accessed only via Apple Screen Sharing so no one else can see your screen. On 20x you can enable a dedicated machine: the entire high-spec Mac Studio or Mac mini serves only you, isolated right down to the hardware. Your session history, source code and environment variables stay in your own account or machine. You set your own access passwords and encryption, and our team does not actively access your data except for maintenance, security incidents or troubleshooting you authorise.

items.q: Where are the machines and networks located?
items.a_html: Our physical high-spec Mac Studio and Mac mini machines are located in Australia, the United States, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Cambodia, New Zealand and Canada, connected via local native ISP broadband networks (not shared public cloud data centers) for maximum reliability. Pick your preferred region at checkout, and we assign you a fixed machine and account for the long term (whole machine dedicated on 20x).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Zaokit ClaudeOps
privacy.meta: Effective date: 3 November 2026. If versions in different languages differ, the English version prevails.
privacy.lead_html: This policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your personal information when providing Zaokit ClaudeOps. We handle personal information in line with the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).

sections.body_html:
• Contact and account details: your name, email address and the preferred region you choose at checkout.
  • Payment information: processed by Stripe / Airwallex. We never see or store your full card number; we can only see transaction records, receipts and payment status.
  • Service information: third-party account emails you provide to set up the Service (such as Claude, Google or Apple accounts) and the access credentials we issue to you.
  • Communications: messages you send us by email, Telegram or other channels.
  • Website data: device, browser, IP address and pages visited, collected through analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Umami.

We use this information only to set up and deliver the Service, handle billing and renewals, provide support, keep our systems secure and prevent abuse, meet legal obligations, and improve our website and Service. We do not sell your personal information.

Files, code and sessions you store in your environment belong to you. We do not actively access them, and only take necessary action for system maintenance, security incidents, legal requirements or troubleshooting you have authorised.

We only share necessary information with:

  • service providers we need to deliver the Service, such as payment processing (Stripe / Airwallex), website analytics, and network and infrastructure providers;
  • third-party providers, where needed to manage subscriptions on your behalf;
  • authorities, where required by law or a lawful government request.

Our environments are located in Australia, the United States, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Cambodia, New Zealand and Canada, and providers such as Stripe / Airwallex may process data in other countries. Your information may therefore be stored or processed outside your country. We take reasonable steps to protect it.

• Contact, account and billing information: kept while you use the Service and afterwards for as long as tax, accounting or other laws require.
  • Data in your environment: may be deleted 7 days after the Service ends.

We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, such as access controls and account isolation. However, no internet transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee that information will never be accessed without authorisation.
Our website uses analytics tools to understand how it is used, and these tools may use cookies or similar technologies. You can disable cookies in your browser settings and still browse the site.

You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal information, except where we must keep it by law. If you have a concern about how we handle your information, please contact us first. If we cannot resolve it, you may complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).
We may update this policy from time to time and will publish the updated version on this page. We will give advance notice of material changes by email or on our website.
For privacy questions, email jason2023zhang@gmail.com (alternative: support@zaokit.ai).

sections.body_html: The Service may be billed monthly or annually and you can cancel at any time. After you cancel, the Service continues until the end of the current billing period (monthly or annual) and will not renew. To cancel, email us.

For this reason, fees for the current billing period (including discounted annual prepayments) are generally not refundable after delivery and are not pro-rated by day or month, except as set out in section 4 or where required by law.

If the Service is unavailable for more than 72 consecutive hours for reasons within our control, we will extend your service period by the number of days affected. If you would rather cancel, you may request a pro-rata refund for the unused part of the current period.

Impact caused by third-party providers (including Anthropic, Google and Apple), such as policy changes, usage limits, account restrictions or outages, is not within our control, and third-party fees already paid on your behalf are not refundable. We will make reasonable efforts to help you resolve the issue.
